entry.prompt: Mossy boulder with glowing mushrooms: one low rounded rock mass under a thick moss cap, a cluster of five chunky round-capped mushrooms growing from a crack on one side and two more on top, all fused to the rock. Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game, stylized painted realism. Chunky faceted planes, hard edges, flat faces, solid closed volume. About 1 m wide and 0.8 m tall. Isolated, no ground, no base plate, no text.
entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Rock: pale silver-grey (#B5B7AE) with cool grey-teal shadows (#7E8F8C). Moss: soft fresh green (#6E9A55) with lighter tips (#93B86E). Mushroom caps: luminous pale cyan (#9FE3DA) with white spots, stems pale ivory (#E6E0CE), the brightest part of the model and clearly visible from above. No text or logos.
